data.text:
Farukh And Another vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 23 
August, 2024 
Author: Neeraj Tiwari
Bench: Neeraj Tiwari
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:136141
Court No. - 51
Case :- Writ - C No. - 27644 of 2024
Petitioner :- Farukh And Another
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others 
Counsel for Petitioner :- Krishna Gopal Singh,Sudhir Kumar Singh Parmar Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Neeraj Tiwari,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner.
2. Present petition has been filed with following prayer:-
"(i). Issue an order/direction to respondent no. 3-Food Safety Appellate Tribunal,
Allahabad/District Judge, Allahabad, mandal Allahabad to decide Safety Appeal No.
22 of 2021 (Shri Farukh & antoher vs. Food Safety Officer, Sri Santosh Kumar, food &
Farukh And Another vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 23 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83897474/
1 drug department, collectorate, Farrukhabad), within stipulated period."
3. Learned counsel for petitioner submitted that aforesaid appeal is pending since long, therefore, a direction may be issued to decide the same at the earliest. 
4. In the facts and circumstances of the case, the present petition is disposed of with direction to respondent no. 3 to decide the aforesaid appeal expeditiously, in accordance with law, without granting any unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties. 
Order Date :- 23.8.2024 Sartaj  Farukh And Another vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 23 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83897474/
2
